name: 573-chop-logs
notes: #573 two woodcutters at ONE grown wild tree (the cap is two to a tree), each with their own tempo (pace 0.92 / 1.08, as PeopleView now varies it) and phase so they never strike together; then chopper A is done and walks off carrying a Log to the stash. NOT drawn here (view FX in Unity, ChopLogsView / HitFx): chips on every hit, a log lying on the ground every 4th hit, the logs lifted when the carry starts. AnimLab shows those.
